agents.name: implementer
agents.prompt: Read SPEC.md and tests/test_slug.py with the read tool. Implement the missing behavior in slug.py without changing SPEC.md or any tests. Use bash to execute python3 /opt/pi-lab/verify-unittest.py --start-dir tests. Report actual commands, failures, and remaining limitations. Do not claim tests ran without invoking them.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.prompt: Read SPEC.md, slug.py, and the acceptance tests independently. Report concrete discrepancies and edge cases with file/line references. The project is read-only; do not change files. Treat another agent's claim as unverified. State any limitations and whether acceptance criteria are covered.
